title: Workflow on push to main: update-branch open claude/* PRs that are behind and clean; comment on conflict only
note: [2026-10-13 AUTO-WAVE1] .github/workflows/branch-sync.yml (push to main, 90s debounce) + scripts/ci/branch_sync.py: update-branch (merge commit) for open same-repo claude/* PRs that are behind, declare tier 1 self, carry no landing:hold label and touch no Tier-2/3 path; conflicts get one comment per head; max 10 per run. REQUIRES the BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN secret (GITHUB_TOKEN updates raise no checks) - without it the job refuses and updates nothing. Built, not yet observed live.
